comment: Pretty easy. Writes outline on the chalkboard in beginning of class. Straightforward. Graded midterm. Optional (not really) paper at the end. Final exam is essays and MC (MC are worth 2/3 of grade). Likes 'loss of consortium' and product liability. Talks about football. Not the clearest, but torts is pretty easy to figure out. Look at past exams.

Professor Swisher is a great, intelligent professor. He is really funny and his method of teaching is is very straightforward. He does socratic cold calling, but the class is mostly lecture.  We had a graded midterm, a final and an optional 6 page paper. His exams are hard, but not unfair.
Took every class he taught, great man, not a fan of lewd and lacivious co-habitation
Excellent professor that really made the subject interesting.  Will definitely be taking some of his other courses.
I hated this class, and the final exam was multiple choice. I would not take his class again.

Prof. Swisher is a great, funny guy. It was easy to have an early-morning class with him because he is very entertaining and low-pressure. Exams were graded a little harder than I expected which is an unpleasant surprise, but overall he is very reasonable and a good teacher.
